interpreter_boundary.reference_scope: Main-first Click controls establish the compatibility difference. Child-first results and independent datetime-only controls are preserved, including interpreter crashes.

known_gaps.area: Import and command invocation in Python subinterpreters
known_gaps.reference: Click 8.5.1 imports and invokes commands in CPython 3.12 isolated and shared-GIL subinterpreters after initialization in the main interpreter.
known_gaps.reference_environment_limit: Child-first experiments can expose a CPython 3.12 datetime-extension teardown crash on the local host, also reproduced without Click or zclick. Raw return codes and independent datetime-only controls remain in the diagnostic report; no imports are preheated to hide this behavior.
known_gaps.candidate: zclick requires the main interpreter. Its native module rejects initialization in subinterpreters with ImportError.
known_gaps.reason: The pinned PyO3 0.30.1 binding does not support independent subinterpreter module and type state. Bypassing its isolation checks would risk sharing Python objects across interpreters.
known_gaps.safety_requirement: Reject both isolated and shared-GIL subinterpreters before initializing PyO3 caches; keep the main interpreter usable afterward.
known_gaps.disclosure: This is an unfinished compatibility item. Passing the fixed upstream suite does not establish unrestricted Click compatibility. Releases with this gap remain explicitly disclosed prereleases.
